app.name: AI Tribe
login.title: Motor Claim Damage Detection AI Model
login.subtitle: Use your email or username and password to access this instance.
login.error_inactive: This account has been deactivated. Contact an administrator.
help.lead: Submit up to 10 photos and an optional short video of vehicle damage. Watch the assessment pipeline run, then review a parts-priced survey estimate.
help.vehicle_forensics_desc: Authenticity and reuse checks on submitted media before pricing starts.
help.deepfake_desc: Screens submitted photos for AI-generation and deepfake artefacts before pricing starts.
help.vmmr_desc: Make/model recognition with confidence tiers — low-confidence guesses need surveyor confirmation.
help.consistency_desc: Compares images within a claim so mixed-vehicle submissions surface as risk signals.
help.fraud_graph_desc: Network of claimants, surveyors, and garages linked by shared claims — flags high-degree nodes and recurring garage–surveyor pairs.
help.parts_estimate_desc: Maps damage to catalogue parts and prices; public-source prices are indicative only.

estimate.title: Survey estimate
estimate.extensive_damage_body: The assessment detected a possible extensive or total-loss pattern across multiple images. No auto-generated settlement total is shown. A surveyor must confirm damage scope and vehicle identity before pricing.
estimate.low_confidence_tier: Low-confidence tier — confirm before final pricing
estimate.approximate_body: No exact catalogue rows for this model. Unit prices use a same-make substitute ({substitute}). Treat totals as indicative until confirmed.
estimate.needs_confirmation_body: VMMR identified this vehicle as {make} {model}, but that class is in a low-confidence tier. Confirm make/model before relying on this estimate.
estimate.provisional_body: Make/model were not confirmed with sufficient confidence. Pricing uses the nearest catalogue match ({label}).
